blocks.name: ConvNeXt-Tiny fundus baseline

blocks.status_label: Complete · best checkpoint epoch 16; one official image-split test pass

gate_title: Image-split research training underway; independent clinical validation remains open
gate_detail: The camera-scope/label audit is complete. Seventeen RFMiD disease or finding targets are listed individually; unsupported labels remain untrained. The official split is image-level with no patient identifiers, so the current work is development evidence only.
gpu_status: Golden Retina L4 running · disease sweep process not detected; inspect before closeout · RTX unused
evidence: NEI describes dilation as enabling retinal and optic-nerve inspection and screening for DR, glaucoma and AMD; the camera still captures only its actual field of view.
RFMiD is a 3,200-image, 46-condition multi-label fundus dataset from three cameras with expert consensus labels; patient-level separation is not established by the official image-level split.
OCTDL was removed from this camera-only training route; its OCT diagnoses cannot count as outputs from camera + 28D images.

Existing DR/GON results remain separate historical research evidence. In this run, the RFMiD multi-label ConvNeXt baseline has completed one image-split test pass; per-disease specialists are now training.
Audited RFMiD positive supports: DR 376/132/124; ARMD 100/38/31; DN 138/46/46; MYA 101/34/32; BRVO 73/23/23; ODC 282/72/91; ODP 65/26/24; ODE 58/21/17; CSR 37/11/13, train/validation/test.
RFMiD audit: 3,200 images, 7,987,571,148 bytes, zero exact duplicate-content groups; patient IDs absent; `Disease_Risk` excluded from disease heads.
Model scope correction: all staged RFMiD trainers use full-field fundus images. No macula/disc crop is claimed because RFMiD supplies no ROI coordinates and no localization detector was validated.
ConvNeXt-Tiny validation at epoch 3: macro AUROC 0.8637 and macro AP 0.3641 across train-support-qualified RFMiD labels. The official image split does not establish patient independence.

DINOv2-Small public checkpoint cached on the L4 at model revision ed25f3a31f01632728cabb09d1542f84ab7b0056; it was fine-tuned for ARMD, but its validation AUROC (0.8636) was below ConvNeXt-Tiny (0.9630), so it was not selected. This is a target-specific image-split development comparison.
ConvNeXt-Tiny epoch 21 validation: macro AUROC 0.9408 and macro AP 0.5973; best observed validation remains epoch 16 (0.9452 / 0.6022).
RFMiD baseline test pass completed after validation-based checkpoint selection: macro AUROC 0.9461, macro AP 0.5387, mean label accuracy 72.72%. RFMiD IDs do not establish patient independence.

Per-label baseline metrics were extracted from the RFMiD image-split test summary for all 17 specialist targets plus MH visibility; see aggregate/rfmid_convnext_multilabel_baseline_summary.json. Accuracy is threshold-0.5 and can be inflated by class imbalance; sensitivity, specificity, AUROC, AP and misses are shown alongside it.

issues.title: Camera field and image protocol not validated

issues.title: Patient-level independence cannot be established
issues.detail: Exact-duplicate audit found no duplicates, but patient IDs are absent and the official splits are image-level; patient independence cannot be verified.
issues.next_action: Obtain a patient-identified cohort or explicitly limit conclusions to image-split development.

issues.title: Rare disease labels may be unsupported
issues.detail: Seventeen RFMiD disease/finding targets are individually tiered; a separate prior HYGD GON result is historical only. Other sparse RFMiD labels are not trained because support is inadequate.
issues.next_action: The 17-target sweep is complete. Keep low-support labels exploratory and seek a patient-identified independent cohort for stronger evaluation.

issues.title: Many clinical diagnoses need unavailable modalities
issues.detail: Corneal topography, slit lamp, OCT and systemic measurements are outside the camera + 28D input contract.
issues.next_action: Keep explicit no-go list; no OCTDL metrics in the camera-only model.

issues.title: Clinical use is not established
issues.detail: These public-data experiments do not establish clinical validity, intended-use performance, or real-world benefit.
issues.next_action: Keep all outputs research-only pending appropriate external and prospective evaluation.

disease_scope.name: Diabetic retinopathy grade / referable DR
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Color fundus · DDR, DeepDRiD, DRTiD, RFMiD
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Full-field binary ConvNeXt-Tiny vs DINOv2 ViT-S/14; separate grading task remains outside this RFMiD sweep
disease_scope.notes: RFMiD support: 376 train / 132 validation / 124 test positives. Separate DR grading workflows exist, but RFMiD grade semantics differ.

disease_scope.name: AMD / drusen / macular pigment and atrophy findings
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Color fundus · RFMiD ARMD/DN and related findings
disease_scope.status_label: Retain · separate ARMD and drusen finding targets
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Full-field ConvNeXt-Tiny vs DINOv2 ViT-S/14; crop deferred without validated localization
disease_scope.notes: RFMiD ARMD support 100/38/31; DN drusen support 138/46/46. Train separate ARMD/drusen tasks; do not equate drusen with AMD.

disease_scope.name: Glaucomatous optic-disc appearance / GON suspect
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Color fundus · HYGD and RFMiD disc findings
disease_scope.status_label: Retain as suspect/finding, not definitive glaucoma
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Full-field ConvNeXt-Tiny vs DINOv2; crop deferred without validated disc localization
disease_scope.notes: RFMiD ODC support 282/72/91 positives; HYGD has a separate GON task. Disc image is only a suspect signal, not a diagnosis.

disease_scope.name: Retinal vascular occlusions and hemorrhagic retinopathy signs
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Color fundus · RFMiD BRVO/CRVO/BRAO/CRAO/HR; low-support labels likely
disease_scope.status_label: Conditional · train only if support threshold is met
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Full-field EfficientNet-B0 / ConvNeXt-Tiny vs DINOv2 candidate; lesion crops deferred
disease_scope.notes: RFMiD BRVO support 73/23/23 (primary tier); CRVO 28/8/9 (low-support exploratory); BRAO 2/2/0 and CRAO 2/2/0 untrained. No acute occlusion rule-out claim.

disease_scope.name: Pathologic myopia, RP, ERM, CSR, macular-hole and scar findings
disease_scope.status_label: Conditional · finding-level outputs; rare labels exploratory
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Full-field ConvNeXt-Tiny; compare DINOv2 only on same split
disease_scope.notes: MYA 101/34/32 primary; ERM 14/7/5 low-support exploratory; CSR 37/11/13 primary; MS 15/5/7 and RT 14/6/5 low-support exploratory; MHL 11/3/3 and RP 6/2/2 untrained.

disease_scope.name: Disc edema, pallor, cupping and other optic-nerve findings
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Full-field ResNet-50 optic-disc finding tasks; no localized crop labels
disease_scope.notes: RFMiD ODE 58/21/17, ODP 65/26/24, ODC 282/72/91. Image-level findings only; causes cannot be determined from one photograph.

disease_scope.name: Retinal detachment, tear, lattice and peripheral holes
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Peripheral retina · planned camera field not verified as complete
disease_scope.notes: No verified retinal-detachment column in the audited RFMiD label CSV; peripheral capture is not guaranteed.

disease_scope.name: DME / macular edema / macular traction as definitive diagnoses
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Color fundus may show clues; OCT excluded from device input
disease_scope.status_label: No-go as definitive classification on this device
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: None; only nonspecific visible macular-abnormality flag may be explored
disease_scope.notes: No OCT in device input; no definitive edema model. DME/OCTDL is excluded from this camera-only run.

disease_scope.name: Cataract / media opacity
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Anterior segment; fundus image may only be degraded
disease_scope.status_label: No-go as disease diagnosis; image-quality gate only
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Media-haze/visibility signal only if source label is retained; no cataract or separate quality model trained in this run
disease_scope.notes: No anterior-segment image in the current input contract.

disease_scope.name: Keratitis, corneal ulcer, corneal dystrophy, corneal edema
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Cornea/anterior segment · slit lamp or anterior imaging required
disease_scope.notes: Not visible in the posterior fundus camera path.

disease_scope.name: Keratoconus
disease_scope.notes: Example explicitly excluded by the camera + 28D-only constraint.

disease_scope.name: Dry eye, blepharitis, conjunctivitis, anterior uveitis, hyphema
disease_scope.dataset_modality: External/anterior segment · slit lamp and symptoms
disease_scope.notes: Not classifiable from a fundus image.

disease_scope.name: Nephropathy and systemic disease
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Laboratory/systemic data; retinal findings are indirect
disease_scope.notes: Not an eye disease and not diagnosable from the planned image.

disease_scope.name: ROP, inherited disease subtype, optic neuritis, endophthalmitis, ocular tumor
disease_scope.dataset_modality: Specialized pediatric imaging, clinical context, multimodal tests or examination
disease_scope.notes: Visible clues do not validate disease-specific detection; no suitable supported cohort is staged.

disease_scope.name: RFMiD other source-defined labels (e.g. tortuous vessels, shunt, exudation, pigment changes, vitreous/preretinal hemorrhage, vasculitis)
disease_scope.status_label: Keep in inventory; train/report only support-eligible labels
disease_scope.candidate_architecture: Full-field ConvNeXt-Tiny or DINOv2 head selected on validation only
disease_scope.notes: Full audited label supports are in the disease-scope document. Several targets have 0–6 training positives; the trainer masks heads below 10 positives or negatives.
